article.title: U.S. Court to review Venezuela’s First Lady Cilia Flores’ pretrial release request on October 8 (+CODEPINK)
article.author: Orinoco Tribune
article.content: Flores filed her application on September 9, requesting permission to await trial under strict home detention because of what her lawyers describe as a serious and continuously deteriorating cardiac condition.
